static_traits.name: Chen Jing
static_traits.occupation: An aspiring singer (often booking local gigs)
static_traits.family_status: Father once Worked at GE; other family members and structure Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends, but hard to express Self-doubt and Fear to them; Interpersonal relationships generally stable
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not yet received psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, able to cooperate with counseling; skeptical when positively reframing, often using negating self-evaluations (like 'you are not good enough' 'this has no meaning'), focusing on the 'big picture' while dismissing small achievements; emotionally showing Anxiety and Depression

basic_info.main_problem: As a singer booking local gigs, I constantly feel these will not lead to a bigger career, and this thought pattern is causing stress and Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts are affecting my confidence, performance quality, and overall well-being.

core_beliefs: I am destined to never succeed

special_situations.event: The moment before going on stage at a local show
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If this gig cannot soon bring a bigger stage or opportunity, it means my career prospects are destined not to succeed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to stay positive, focusing on the present to hedge Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will not bring a bigger career either, efforts are all in vain

special_situations.event: Thinking of more successful Musicians in the industry and comparing before or during gig preparation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot reach the level of those more successful Musicians, it proves I am not good enough, and will have no future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing disclosure of Self-doubt and Fear to friends, to avoid being judged or appearing vulnerable
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Receiving audience praise or positive feedback after performances
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless achieving industry-level major success, scattered praise does not count, utterly meaningless to the whole
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying or negating small achievements, to maintain a 'rational big-picture view'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This praise is utterly meaningless in the big picture

special_situations.event: When reviewing career progress, attention focused on inadequacies and the uncertain future
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative information is more real and reliable; only major breakthroughs count as progress
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 'Staying realistic' by emphasizing industry competition and own inadequacies, ignoring current concrete progress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter how well things go now, the future is still terrible

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized, having greater Career development and success
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and the exposure of the self 'I am not good enough', worrying about greater disappointment after hopes are shattered
defense_goal: Rarely talking to others about Self-doubt to avoid being judged or appearing vulnerable

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough singer with bleak prospects
object_relations.object_representation: The industry and successful people are harsh judges / unreachable standards

object_relations.self_representation: The party finding it hard to expose vulnerability
object_relations.object_representation: Friends are supporters but may not understand my Self-doubt

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to attend to positive feedback and small achievements (such as audience praise, performances booked)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing these are just trivial, not counting in the 'big picture', a form of self-comfort
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Calm but insistent tone, emphasizing 'the industry is fiercely competitive, these do not matter', citing others' greater success to support own judgment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of disclosing Self-doubt and Fear to supportive friends, seeking emotional support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying about being judged or troubling others, believing such topics should not be raised
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Brief responses like 'I do not talk about these much', avoiding details, restrained tone, quickly Displacing the topic.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked before a performance about expectations for the performance or prospects
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views failure as inevitable; considers positive expectations self-deception
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using absolutist statements (like 'there will never be a bigger career'), firm tone, directly negating possibilities.

manifestations: Viewing audience praise after local gigs as trivial in the 'big picture'
Believing current efforts will not lead to a bigger career
Hard to disclose Self-doubt and Fear to supportive friends
Self-doubt affecting the sense of connection with others
outcomes: Withdrawal in relationships and Increased sense of alienation

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes the standard of 'must achieve greater success to count' using more successful people in the industry as the benchmark
Taking 'small achievements do not count' as a taken-for-granted rule

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When facing audience praise, quickly shifts to the 'big picture' and the fact that others are more successful, avoiding contact with the positive experience of the moment
Finds it hard to directly respond to and open up to friends' support, instead staying silent or expressing vaguely

exception_events.target_problem: Around local gigs, the client is typically trapped by Self-doubt and Anxiety, and negates own progress and positive feedback when reviewing.
exception_events.unique_outcome: After one gig receiving specific praise from the audience, briefly feeling affirmed and having potential in the moment, different from the past quick negation reaction.
exception_events.reason: Different support: live audience giving specific positive feedback; situational cue: immediate praise after the gig keeping attention briefly on the present experience rather than 'macro comparison'.

positive_force: Able to continuously book local performances, with a certain professional ability and resources
Has a supportive network of friends
When receiving specific praise, able to briefly touch the feeling of being affirmed
Having tried strategies of staying positive and focusing on the present
negative_force: Thinking patterns of catastrophizing and predicting failure
Comparing with more successful people leads to self-deprecation
Negating positive feedback, focusing only on shortcomings (mental filtering)
Pre-gig Anxiety and Self-denial undermining confidence and performance
Avoidance of exposing vulnerability keeping support from entering

target_behavior.behavior: Strong pre-gig Anxiety and Self-denial (negative self-talk like 'you are not good enough' 'this has no meaning')
antecedent: Just before going on stage at a local performance
Thinking of more successful Musicians in the industry to compare
Seeing performance schedules and career prospects
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and failure-predicting cognitions, strongly binding self-worth to 'a bigger career', external comparison Reinforcing hopelessness
target_behavior.function: Escaping the risk of potential failure and disappointment (lowering expectations and emotional investment through preemptive negation)
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-confidence, gig quality affected, Anxiety and Increased stress, sleep and Impaired motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding expressing Self-doubt and Fear to friends (reducing help-seeking and emotional disclosure)
antecedent: Being with supportive friends or talking about a music career
Thinking of expressing inner Self-doubt and worries
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about being judged or troubling others; fear of exposing vulnerability
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible negative evaluations and the discomfort brought by vulnerability
target_behavior.consequence: Connection and Decreased support, intensified Loneliness and Withdrawal
